ruleDefinitions.name: WMIC Loading Scripting Libraries
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects threat actors proxy executing code and bypassing application controls by leveraging wmic and the `/FORMAT` argument switch to download and execute an XSL file (i.e js, vbs, etc). Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\wmic\\\.exe$") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\jscript\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\vbscript\\\.dll$")))
